name: Open official TradingView chart and Pine Editor link
description: Verifies the chart remains available and the RSI study is replaced by the named custom indicator guide without changing the chart's existing signal levels.
steps: Inspect the official TradingView Advanced Chart Widget
Use the Open Pine Editor link to open TradingView in a new tab
Open Website settings, change chart appearance or timezone, then apply
expected: The official TradingView chart loads, the Pine Editor link opens TradingView in a new tab, and website settings allow changing chart appearance, timezone, and timeframe.

name: Evaluate live Binance seven-timeframe reversal roadmap
covers: all-green SELL arming with D1 RSI above 70
all-red BUY arming with D1 RSI below 30
fresh completed 15m EMA20 EMA50 crossover after arming
main signal grid shows per-timeframe MA and RSI alignment
BUY SELL WAIT metrics use confirmed roadmap signals
description: Verifies the live roadmap applies the strict D1, all-timeframe and fresh completed 15-minute crossover rules to Binance crypto candles.
steps: Open the BPQT Reversal Roadmap and select a Binance crypto market
Inspect the seven timeframe MA/RSI badges in the main signal grid and roadmap matrix
Review D1 RSI, armed status, fresh 15-minute crossover and the BUY/SELL/WAIT totals
expected: SELL arms only when all seven rows are bullish and D1 RSI is above 70; BUY arms only when all seven rows are bearish and D1 RSI is below 30. Once armed, the setup stays remembered even if D1 RSI or timeframe alignment changes. A confirmed signal additionally requires a fresh completed 15m EMA20/EMA50 crossover after arming and 15m RSI below 50 for SELL or above 50 for BUY. Otherwise the signal remains WAIT.

name: Keep unsupported markets and incomplete feeds out of confirmed signals
covers: Binance public WebSocket ticker and kline feeds
live prices and completed candle indicators
unsupported forex metals and indices are marked no feed
incomplete seven-timeframe data does not fabricate signals
description: Verifies the live scanner does not present unsupported markets or incomplete timeframe data as confirmed signals.
steps: Open the dashboard and inspect Binance connection status
Inspect a crypto row and its seven timeframe badges
Filter to forex, metals or indices and inspect the feed label
expected: Crypto rows show live Binance data and per-timeframe states; non-crypto markets remain NO FEED and incomplete or disconnected crypto data does not produce BUY or SELL confirmations.

name: Live RSI momentum chart and optional feed notes
description: Verifies the momentum panel plots RSI values derived from Binance closed candles, labels zones around the midpoint, and explanatory notes can be shown or hidden.
steps: Open the dashboard and select a crypto market
Inspect the Momentum Zone Tracker current RSI marker and line
Click each question-mark control to show and hide feed explanations
Scroll the BPQT Reversal Roadmap table horizontally
expected: The momentum panel draws a live RSI line from Binance candle history and labels RSI above 50 BUY ZONE and RSI at or below 50 SELL ZONE. Both feed explanations toggle on click, and the roadmap table has horizontal overflow on narrow screens.
